name: Energy Storage and Management
summary:
Energy Storage and Management is an immersive VR training application developed as part of the ImmerseLearn Energy Storage and Management micro-credential program. This application enables learners to gain practical, hands-on experience in a safe and interactive virtual environment designed to simulate real-world energy storage operations and procedures.

Through guided simulations, users can practice essential skills related to energy storage systems, equipment handling, operational workflows, maintenance
